name: The Column
why: Every spell is an area or a projectile; the column sells the shape before the fork sells the element, and the resist star up its middle is the plain way through for a caster who wants neither yet.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: Where the well and the craft meet above the base: a loop, so neither road is a dead choice. Forks to the two shape clusters and to the star.

clusters.name: Prism Ward
clusters.why: The resist star: all resistances and ailment avoidance in the notable, one single-node spoke per element, each landing somewhere else: south on the junction, west on the area cluster, east on the projectile cluster, north on the fork. The column's spine: a caster who wants resistances walks straight up it.

nodes.name: Prism Ward
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units.
The fire spoke, to the junction.
The cold spoke, to the area cluster.
The lightning spoke, to the projectile cluster.
The chaos spoke, to the fork.

clusters.name: Broad Weave
clusters.why: Spell area: radius and area damage, tagged spell so the Wall's slams do not shop here. West of the column, reached from the junction, the star's cold spoke and (since G3) Composure from the Cloister; passed through to the fork and onto the Withering chain.

nodes.why: The entrance, south-east, where the star's spoke also arrives.
Where the Withering chain leaves.
The north exit, to the fork.

clusters.name: Darting Bolts
clusters.why: Spell projectiles: damage, speed, cast speed. East of the column, reached from the junction and the star's lightning spoke; passed through to the fork and onto the Lingering chain.

nodes.why: The entrance, south, where the star's spoke also arrives.

nodes.name: Darting Bolts
nodes.why: 2 + 1 + 1 units.
Where the Lingering chain leaves.
The east side.

clusters.name: Withering
clusters.why: Damage over time, then the notable with damage over time and the chaos damage over time multiplier: for the Mystic's plague spells, as a chain from the area cluster to the west arm's first cluster. A second way into the west arm. Cold over time is on the other side of the column (Lingering), so the frost-ground caster and the plague caster do not share a chain.

nodes.name: Withering
nodes.why: 2 + 1.6 units.

clusters.name: Lingering
clusters.why: Skill effect duration, then the notable with duration and the cold damage over time multiplier: for the Mystic's frozen ground and other duration spells, as a chain from the projectile cluster to the east arm's first cluster. A second way into the east arm.

nodes.name: Lingering
nodes.why: Longer effects and the damage that ticks through them: 1.6 + 1.6 units. Cold's own lines are on the arms.

clusters.name: The parting
clusters.why: The element decision: fire north-west, cold north, lightning north-east. An attribute node; the arms are joined again a few steps up (brief §2), and the bridges from the shape clusters reach the outer arms without it, so the choice is a cost, not a wall.

clusters.name: The west climb
clusters.why: Intelligence twice: the road from the fork up to the Lantern arm.

clusters.name: The east climb
clusters.why: Intelligence twice: the road from the fork up to the Gallery arm.

links.why: Junction to the star's fire spoke: the spine.
The star's cold spoke to the area cluster.
The star's lightning spoke to the projectile cluster.
The star's chaos spoke to the fork: the spine reaches the arms.
Junction to the area cluster.
Junction to the projectile cluster.
The area cluster to the fork.
The projectile cluster to the fork, from its notable.
The area cluster onto the Withering chain.
The Withering chain lands on the west arm.
The projectile cluster onto the Lingering chain.
The Lingering chain lands on the east arm.
Intelligence twice: the road from the fork up to the Lantern arm.
The far end of the road.
The middle arm.
Intelligence twice: the road from the fork up to the Gallery arm.
The far end of the road.

name: The Scriptorium
why: The busy side of the Spire, toward the Knife: spell damage and cast speed on the wheel with a shield on its other side, cost, wand attacks, the insight charges, the curses and an aura pocket on the Knife border, and Mana Bastion.

clusters.name: Ready Wit
clusters.why: The wheel: entered from the craft road on the south-west, left to the junction on the east and the column from its north-west small. Each notable's two smalls are its own lines (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/discipline.md F6: the north-east small was mana, so Ready Wit's side mixed spell damage and mana): Ready Wit, damage and cast speed, on the north side, with a spell damage small and a cast speed small; Warded Mind, chaos resistance and mana, on the south, with a mana small and a chaos resistance small, the defence a caster forgets until a poisoner finds it. Cast speed rather than a second spell damage small, so spell damage near home stays scarce. Until G3 (2026-10-22, G1/mystic.md MY-r1) the south side was energy shield, so the wheel handed a caster spell damage and energy shield on its two sides seven steps out; the near energy shield is west now (Glass Skin). The Spire's spell crit is elsewhere: Sharp Mind at home, Flashpoint and Fever Pitch up the east and middle arms, Keen Verse on the east road.

nodes.why: The entrance, south-west.
The north-east exit, to the junction: Ready Wit's cast speed (mana until G4 fix 1).
Chaos resistance, the south side's stat (energy shield until G3, MY-r1).

nodes.name: Warded Mind
nodes.why: The chaos resistance a caster lacks, with mana and a little regeneration: 2 + 1 + 1 units. No energy shield since G3 (MY-r1): the east wheel is spell damage or chaos resistance, not spell damage and energy shield.

clusters.name: Frugal
clusters.why: Reduced mana cost, then the notable with cost reduction and regeneration: the caster who casts without stopping, as a side room off the damage notable, so the east has a mana answer and the west's mana is not the only one. (Swapped with the wand chain on 2026-10-20.)

nodes.name: Frugal
nodes.why: 2 + 1 units.

clusters.name: Wand Volley
clusters.why: The wand as a weapon, not a stat stick: wand attack damage twice, then the notable with wand attack damage and attack speed with wands, the fast wand. Four attack gems take a wand and the kit is one; the Spire sold nothing for them. A chain from the wand room's far node up to the projectile cluster's east side, so the wand attacker reaches the projectiles without the column's junction. Its crit went in G3 (2026-10-22, G1/mystic.md MY-r3): the crit wand is a cluster of its own on the Eaves, and the elemental wand (Bright Wand) is in the Lantern, so the four wand clusters have four partners.

nodes.why: The entrance, from Wandwork.

nodes.name: Wand Volley
nodes.why: 2 + 2.4 units.
The exit, to the projectile cluster.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The craft's junction, east of the wheel: the insight room south-east, the Mana Bastion spur north-east, the Hexwright chain east toward the Knife.

clusters.name: Flashes of Insight
clusters.why: Insight charges (40% crit chance each): a charge more, charges on crit, longer charges. The crit caster's commitment, a side room.

nodes.name: Flashes of Insight
nodes.why: A fourth insight charge (3 units by the table) and a way to gain them: 4.

clusters.name: Kept Vows
clusters.why: Reduced reservation twice, then the notable with reservation and energy shield: the aura caster's chain from the junction east toward the Knife, where it crosses onto the wheel of the Stair. Here since round 3 (2026-10-20), when it traded places with Hexwright; it sat in the west beside the Cathedral's choir until earlier that day. The choir is the other place to buy auras.

nodes.name: Kept Vows
nodes.why: Room for an aura and the shield it is reserved against: 1.7 + 1.6 units.

clusters.name: Hexwright
clusters.why: Curse effect twice, then the notable with curse effect and mana regeneration: the curse caster's pocket, the hexer who keeps casting its curses (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/discipline.md F2: its curse area was a dead line, since a cast curse uses its gem's own radius, and its skill duration probably does not reach a cast curse either; cast speed would copy Grim Oath's pairing). It is the first of the east road, above the Kept Vows chain. It was the chain toward the Knife until round 3 (2026-10-20), three steps from the Stair's chaos-spell notable and seven from Second Curse, so a chaos hexer was done by point 17; now they are seven and eleven.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the Kept Vows chain.

clusters.name: Mist Walk
clusters.why: Chance to dodge spells twice, then the notable with spell dodge, attack dodge and movement: the caster's defence that is not a pool, the second pocket of the east road, landing on the lightning arm's junction.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing Draught.

clusters.name: Mana Bastion
clusters.why: Two nodes of shield and mana, then the keystone: energy shield protects mana, and costs are paid from energy shield first. The mirror of Mind Bulwark across the column: the two keystones are one decision from either side.

clusters.name: The scriptorium stair
clusters.why: Intelligence twice: the road from the column junction down to the craft wheel.

clusters.name: To the Knife
clusters.why: The near crossing to the Knife (audit 2026-10-20: the Mystic had none near home). Two attribute nodes from the insight pocket down to the Spoils pocket of the Knife Gate: the crit caster and the energy-shield Shade cross here.

clusters.name: To the Alleys
clusters.why: Two attribute nodes from Flashes of Insight to Thick Blood: a near road between the Scriptorium and the Alleys, for the crit caster and the life Shade, and two notables that were dead ends are now on a road.

clusters.name: To Flashpoint
clusters.why: One intelligence node from Mist Walk to Flashpoint: the run from the Gallery stair down to Kept Vows had no branch for seven nodes.

clusters.name: To Wand Volley
clusters.why: Two intelligence nodes from Hexwright to Wand Volley: the east edge of the Scriptorium is a loop, not a strand.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Intelligence once between Hexwright and Kept Vows.

clusters.name: The curse crossing
clusters.why: One attribute node from Hexwright's notable toward the Shade's Stair junction (G2, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md §3, kept in the join, G1-brief.md §2.1): the curser from either start reaches Hexwright and the Shade's curse home. On the straight line between the two; the last node before the Shade, so half dexterity. Its link onward to the Stair's junction was laid by the border pass.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Intelligence once between Mist Walk and Hexwright.

clusters.name: Keen Verse
clusters.why: Spell damage with the spell crit multiplier (G3 round 1, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-1): the crit caster's spell damage, on the east, the Mystic's crit side. A bridge across the gap between Wand Volley, Hexwright and Mist Walk, from the road to Wand Volley up to the road between Mist Walk and Hexwright, laid as a V with the notable at its tip and two spell crit multiplier smalls on each leg. The smalls were plain spell damage until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/builds.md finding 1): every caster took the cluster whatever its partner, and spell damage at 120 points doubled; now the smalls are the partner, so the cluster is the crit caster's and the plain spell damage is on the notable only. Spell damage's directions: cast speed (Ready Wit, 8 steps), crit here, penetration (Piercing Word), regeneration (Long Chant), life (Living Verse). Steps from the Mystic start: 17.

nodes.why: The entrance from the road to Wand Volley, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Keen Verse
nodes.why: 2.5 + 1.5 units. The tip of the V; the bend is here, at the notable.
The exit, on the straight line to the road node between Mist Walk and Hexwright.

clusters.name: Hale Scribe
clusters.why: Life with mana (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-9, the ledger's near life section MY-s6 moved into it): life for the caster on the east, the offence side, so the Scriptorium is not a corridor of spell damage, crit and cost (CONSTRAINTS §4.8), and the Mystic's life lies in three directions with three partners (Warm Blood shield at home, Quiet Pulse regeneration west, mana here; Living Verse's spell damage far west). A bridge from the scriptorium stair to Wand Volley across the gap between the column junction, Darting Bolts, Wand Volley and Frugal, with the bend at the notable so it meets Wand Volley's entrance clear of Frugal's link. Two life smalls each side. 12 steps from the Mystic start: the nearest of the new clusters, and life, which no Mystic build collected too much of.

nodes.why: The entrance from the scriptorium stair, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Hale Scribe
nodes.why: 2.4 + 1.25 units. The bend of the bridge is here, at the notable.
The exit, on the straight line to Wand Volley's entrance.

clusters.name: Sharp Tongue
clusters.why: Spell damage with a dagger and cast speed (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-10): the dagger caster's cluster on the Mystic side of the border, a bridge from Mist Walk's notable to the Shade's crossing road below the Stair (the dagger caster's bridge, G2/borders.md §4). A dagger asks for intelligence and dexterity, so it sits on the int-int border where the Shade's dexterity is a step away. The Shade's dagger caster reaches it, Mist Walk's spell dodge and Keen Verse; the Mystic caster reaches the Stair. A V with the bend at the notable: the Shade side arrives at the crossing road from due west, square to the road, and the Mystic side runs straight to Mist Walk. Two dagger smalls on the Mystic side, one on the Shade side. 18 steps from the Mystic start and 16 from the Shade's; Keen Verse (spell damage, crit) is 9 away.

nodes.why: The entrance from Mist Walk's notable, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Sharp Tongue
nodes.why: 2.5 + 1.5 units. The tip of the V.
The Shade side, to the crossing road.

links.why: The scriptorium stair onto Hale Scribe (MY-9): the stair is a junction now, not a bare run.
Hale Scribe onto Wand Volley's entrance: a bridge, so the column junction reaches the fast wand without the wheel and Frugal.
Mist Walk onto Sharp Tongue (MY-10): the spell dodge notable becomes a junction toward the Shade's Stair.

The dagger caster's bridge (G2/borders.md §4, laid in G3 round 2): Sharp Tongue onto the Shade's crossing road below the Stair's junction, so the Shade's dagger caster reaches the Mystic's dagger spells and Mist Walk, and the Mystic caster the Stair.
The road to Wand Volley onto Keen Verse (MY-1): the road had nothing coming off it between Hexwright and Wand Volley.
Keen Verse onto the road between Mist Walk and Hexwright: a bridge, so the gap is crossed through spell damage, and the east road has a second way from Wand Volley to Mist Walk.
Wand Volley onto the far small of Frugal, not the notable: the two sit three steps apart.
The near crossing to the Knife leaves from the Kept Vows chain's small, not from the notable, so Kept Vows is not a step from the notables of the Stair.
Two intelligence nodes from Hexwright to Wand Volley: the east edge of the Scriptorium is a loop, not a strand.
The far end of the road.
One intelligence node from Mist Walk to Flashpoint: the run from the Gallery stair down to Kept Vows had no branch for seven nodes.
The far end of the road.

Two attribute nodes from Flashes of Insight to Thick Blood: a near road between the Scriptorium and the Alleys, for the crit caster and the life Shade, and two notables that were dead ends are now on a road.
The far end of the road.
Frugal back onto the craft junction, so the Mana Bastion spur is a spur and not the way to Frugal.
The insight pocket onto the crossing.
The crossing lands on the Spoils pocket of the Knife Gate.
The cost room opens off the damage notable.
The wand attack chain lands on the projectile cluster's east side, which had no door: a wand attack is not a projectile, but the wand attacker and the bolt caster share a wheel.
Intelligence once between Flashes of Insight and the Kept Vows chain.
The wheel's east side to the junction.
Junction to the insight room.
Junction to the Kept Vows chain.
Junction to the keystone spur.
Intelligence twice: the road from the column junction down to the craft wheel.
The far end of the road.
Intelligence once between Kept Vows and Hexwright.
The far end of the road.
Intelligence once between Mist Walk and Hexwright.
The far end of the road.
Hexwright onto the curse crossing: the curse notable is on the way to the Stair, so a curser coming from the Shade pays for it and one from the Mystic walks on to the Shade curses.

The curse crossing (a near crossing; G1-brief.md §2.1, laid in the G2 border pass): Hexwright through one node to the Stair's junction, so the curser from either start has the other's curses (Hexwright with Second Curse and the Shade's curse cluster). The Stair's west becomes a loop: the junction, Hexwright, Kept Vows, the hex wheel, the climb.
Intelligence once, between the Gallery junction and Mist Walk.
The far end of the road.

name: The Lantern
why: The arm toward the Cathedral: a careful cold caster's shield, the elemental wand, the Spire's minions, and the slow fire of the burn. The dear crossing from the Cathedral's crypt lands on the minion notable.

clusters.name: Hoarfrost
clusters.why: Cold with energy shield: the careful cold caster's cluster, who wants the chill to keep things off and a shield for what gets through. The other cold cluster (Shatter, at the top) sells freeze and penetration instead, so a cold build picks safety here or the big hit up there, and both costs a crossing.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the fork.
The west exit, to the arm's junction.
The north exit, to the inter-arm junction.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The arm's junction: the ignite room north-west, the dear crossing from the Cathedral's minions west, and the well's west road arriving from the south.

clusters.name: Familiars
clusters.why: Minions in the Spire (2026-10-19, the user's review: the Mystic can pick a summon like any other gem and the region sold nothing for one). Minion damage twice, then the notable with minion damage, minion life and spell damage (the summoning caster's), as a chain from the west road's mana-leech pocket to the arm's junction: the Spire's half of the dear crossing to the Cathedral's minion tower, which lands on its notable, so a minion Mystic and a fire Zealot pass each other here.

nodes.why: The entrance, from Mana Tap.

nodes.name: Familiars
nodes.why: The caster's minions: 2 + 1 + 1 units. The Cathedral's minion tower arrives here.
The exit, to the arm's junction.

clusters.name: Cinder
clusters.why: Ignite: chance, burning damage, faster burning. Fire as a burn, at the arm's end beside the two-element keystone; the fire caster who wants the hit instead goes east to Flashpoint. The arm's end: a dead end since 2026-10-20, when its link to the Prismatic spur went so the keystone sits on a spur; a bridge again since G2 (2026-10-22), its far side leading on to the north-west rim road. Since G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22) it is also the Mystic end of seam 2: the Zealot's Bright Omen (spell crit with mana regeneration) lands on its notable, so Cinder is a junction of the Lantern arm, the rim road and the far crossing.

clusters.name: The north-west rim road
clusters.why: Three attribute nodes on one straight run along the Spire's north-west rim (G2, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md §3 as joined in G1-brief.md §2.2): from High Veil (the shield and resistance ring, G3, G1/mystic.md MY-4), past Cold Light's pocket (spell crit with cold, G3 round 3) to the corner over Cinder, where the road turns onto the Zealot's north walk (the far loop). Cinder stops being a dead end. From G3 round 2 to G4 fix 2 the road was a spur with a far tip; since G4 fix 2 (2026-10-23) Steady Stream leads onto High Veil again, so the road is one side of a loop from the climb to Shatter round to Cinder. The north-east rim road is the Eaves (`rim.ts`).

nodes.why: The head of the road: High Veil (G3) lands here on a small, on the straight line of the road. Moved in G3 from (-850,-4500) to the middle of the run, clear of the ring.
Halfway; the end of Cold Light's short leg (G3 round 3).
The corner over Cinder, the last node before the Zealot, so half strength: the far loop leaves here for the Zealot's north walk, and Cold Light's longer leg leaves here.

clusters.name: Cold Light
clusters.why: Spell crit with cold damage (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; new beyond the brief, CONSTRAINTS §1.1 and §5.1): the cold caster's crit, the Spire's fourth spell crit cluster and its first away from the east. Spell crit had three homes, all on the east side and all near (Sharp Mind at home, Flashpoint, Keen Verse), so a crit caster had all of it by 60 points and 40 more points bought none (G3 round 2: the life caster's spell crit 8.4 units from 60 to 160). Here it is far and in the other direction, and its partner is cold: the fire and lightning caster pays for a cold line it does not use, the cold caster for crit it half wants. Cold's third cluster too, each with its own partner (the shield at Hoarfrost, freeze and penetration at Shatter, crit here), nine steps from Hoarfrost through Cinder. Laid where round 3 first put the minion-and-curse cluster (moved to the Eaves: it made the north-west a summoner's one-stop beside High Veil and Familiars). A V pocket outward of the north-west rim road, the notable at the tip under the rim: two crit smalls on the corner's side, where a caster arrives from Cinder or the Zealot's north walk, one on the side toward High Veil. Walking the road costs none of it.

nodes.why: The entrance from the corner over Cinder, on the straight line to the notable.
Beside the notable, on the same leg.

nodes.name: Cold Light
nodes.why: 2 + 1.6 units. The tip of the V.
The exit to the road's middle node, on the straight line from the notable.

clusters.name: The lantern stair
clusters.why: Intelligence twice: the road down from the Lantern junction to the well.

clusters.name: Bright Wand
clusters.why: Wand attacks with elemental damage with attacks (G3 round 1, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-5): the elemental wand, the third of four wand-attack clusters, each with its own partner and direction (accuracy at home, speed on the east, elements here, crit on the Eaves later). Brought into the first round because the wand attacker was flat at every point count and Wand Volley's re-line (crit to speed) took supply from it (CONSTRAINTS §5.7, §1.1). A four-node ring in the triangle between the Lantern junction, the west join and the Prismatic spur, a bridge parallel to Hoarfrost, so the Lantern and the Belfry's west join are joined twice: through the cold or through the wand. It arrives at the west join from due west, between Hoarfrost's link and the Prismatic spur. 18 steps from the Mystic start, 10 from Wand Volley.

nodes.why: The west side, from the Lantern's junction.

nodes.name: Bright Wand
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units. The north side of the ring.
The east side, to the west join.
The south side.

links.why: The Lantern junction onto Bright Wand (MY-5), east, into the gap between the cold cluster and the ignite room.
Bright Wand onto the Belfry's west join, arriving from due west: a second link between the Lantern and the Belfry beside Hoarfrost's.
Through the cold cluster to the arm's junction.
Junction to the ignite room.
The ignite room's far side onto the north-west rim road: Cinder is a bridge from the Lantern to the rim, not the arm's dead end.
The corner over Cinder onto Cold Light's longer leg, up into the open side between the Zealot's road and the rim road (the corner becomes a four-way: Cinder, the Zealot, the road, the pocket).
Cold Light's short leg onto the road's middle node: the pocket is a bridge, two ways in.
The mana-leech pocket's far node onto the minion chain: a second way from the well to the arm, beside the one through Mana Tap's notable.
The minion chain lands on the arm's junction.
The inter-arm link to the top arm.

name: The Belfry
why: The middle arm, the one both others are joined to, and the top of the Spire: lightning for the quick caster first, cold as the big frozen hit second, and the crit keystone above them. The two-element keystone sits on the west join.

clusters.name: Thunderhead
clusters.why: Lightning with cast speed and a chance to shock: the quick lightning caster's cluster, the first of the middle arm, with the two inter-arm junctions off its sides. The other lightning cluster (Live Current, east) sells shock effect and penetration; this one sells speed.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the fork.
The west side, to the west join.

nodes.name: Thunderhead
nodes.why: 1.6 + 1.25 + 1 units. The north exit.
The east side, to the east join.

clusters.name: West join
clusters.why: The inter-arm junction to the west arm, and the foot of the Prismatic Balance spur.

clusters.name: East join
clusters.why: The inter-arm junction to the east arm.

clusters.name: Prismatic Balance
clusters.why: Two nodes of elemental damage, then the trade: hits give +25% to the hit's elements and -50% to the others for 5 s. Only a two-element rotation profits. A spur off the west join toward the ignite room, a dead end. Its third small went in G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/starts.md F5 and F8): the keystone was 20 steps out on a spur of three, one step nearer now; the keystone sits where the third small was pulled in along the spur's own line.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The arm's junction above the first cluster: the shatter room, and the top spur.

clusters.name: Shatter
clusters.why: Freeze chance, cold penetration and cold damage: cold as the big hit that stops a rare, under the crit keystone. The other cold cluster (Hoarfrost, west) is the safe one with a shield; this one is the dangerous one. Passed through, up to the top spur.

nodes.why: The entrance, south. One unit of freeze chance (5% until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22).

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.why: 1.2 + 1.25 + 2 units. The north exit.

clusters.name: Harsh Weather
clusters.why: Effect of non-damaging ailments twice, then the notable with effect, freeze duration and shock duration: the chill, freeze and shock caster, as a chain off the shatter room's east side. Until 2026-10-20 it ran on to Live Current, which put two notables a shock caster wants both of a step apart; since G3 round 2 its notable leads on to Piercing Word (spell damage), down to the east join.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the shatter room.

nodes.name: Harsh Weather
nodes.why: 2 + 1 + 1 units. The far end of the chain, onto Piercing Word.

clusters.name: Fever Pitch
clusters.why: Two nodes of elemental damage, then the trade: critical strike multiplier fixed at 100%, and 40% more elemental damage for 8 s after a critical strike. The top of the Spire, the farthest keystone of the region (it was three smalls; the walk from the start was already twenty points).

clusters.name: The west climb to Shatter
clusters.why: Two intelligence nodes from the Lantern junction up to Shatter's west side: the top of the Spire, Shatter and Fever Pitch had one way in, through Thunderhead. Since G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22) both nodes carry Quickening's arc, and the upper one Steady Stream as well, so the climb has a branch at each node.

clusters.name: The east climb to Live Current
clusters.why: One intelligence node from the tip of Harsh Weather to Live Current's far small: Harsh Weather is a bridge again, four steps from Live Current, not one.

clusters.name: A road
clusters.why: Intelligence once between Shatter and Harsh Weather.

clusters.name: Snare Line
clusters.why: A chain outward off Harsh Weather's climb to Live Current: trap damage twice, then traps with duration. The caster's trap, for a spell set as a trap and the traps that last; the Docks' Trapper sells traps with area and the Strider's Tripwire traps with throwing speed and cooldown. Round 4 (2026-10-20). Since G2 (2026-10-22) its notable leads on to the Eaves road (`rim.ts`), so the chain is a bridge from Harsh Weather's climb to the rim.

nodes.name: Snare Line
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units.

clusters.name: Siphon
clusters.why: Energy shield on hit, then the notable with shield leech, shield on hit and mana on kill: the caster's recovery from hitting, which no other Spire node sells. Moved here from the Cloister in G2 (2026-10-22, G1/mystic.md MY-m2): it sat three steps from Glass Skin and Quickening, a one-stop for the shield caster; here it is a bridge from the east join to the Belfry's junction, beside Thunderhead's cast speed and under the shock and freeze: the casters who hit often. Laid on the straight line between its two ends, the notable in the middle, with a shield-on-hit small either side (the second added in G3).

nodes.why: The entrance, from the east join.
The exit, to the arm's junction: the second shield-on-hit small (G3, MY-m2), mirroring the first across the notable.

clusters.name: Quickening
clusters.why: Recharge rate and a faster start of recharge: the energy-shield build's decision. Moved here in G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/tradeoffs.md F6) from the Cloister, where it sat with Glass Skin and Composure on the walk west that was every intelligence caster's first half from both the Mystic and the Zealot starts (14 steps from the Zealot's, nearer than from the Mystic's own). Here it is the spine's second shield notable, seven steps from Siphon (shield from hitting) by the shortest way, so the shield caster's three directions are mana at the wheel, stun in the Cloister and recovery up the spine, and the recharge is a Mystic commitment of its own. A V hung outward between the two nodes of the west climb to Shatter, its notable at the tip in the open ground between the climb and the Prismatic spur, a small on the straight line to each road node: walking the climb costs none of it.

nodes.why: The entrance from the climb's lower node, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Quickening
nodes.why: 3 + 1 + 1 units; the faster start is the half the sheet shows least and the fight feels most. The tip of the V.
The exit to the climb's upper node, on the straight line from the notable.

clusters.name: Steady Stream
clusters.why: A chain outward off the road to Shatter: damage with channelling skills twice, then channelling with cheaper mana; since G4 fix 2 a bridge on to High Veil, not a pocket. The channelled spell drinks mana for as long as it is held; the Fosse's Ceaseless Blades sells channelling to attackers, with speed and footing. Round 4 (the user approved channelling as two notables, 2026-10-20).

nodes.name: Steady Stream
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units. The far end of the pocket, which leads on to High Veil: linked in G3 round 1, cut in round 2 (the classic caster took the far shield a step off the climb), linked again in G4 fix 2 (audit/growth-2 network finding 3) now that the loop widens choice.

clusters.name: Piercing Word
clusters.why: Spell damage with elemental penetration (G3 round 1, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-11, where the ledger's spell section MY-s1 went). Moved in G3 round 2 (2026-10-22, the user's ask) off the west climb to Shatter, where Hoarfrost, this, Shatter and High Veil lay 4 to 10 steps apart and read as one destination for a cold caster. Now a chain from the east join up to Harsh Weather's notable, in the open ground between Siphon, Harsh Weather and the Gallery: a cold caster at the top of the column chooses between the cold of the climb (Hoarfrost west, Shatter north) and spell damage north-east, 10 and 7 steps away, and Harsh Weather stops being a dead end. Measured against three other places (the west climb, the north-west rim road beside High Veil): this one left the casters hungriest for both spell damage and shield at 120 points without raising their tax. Spell damage's partners by direction: cast speed (Ready Wit), crit (Keen Verse), life (Living Verse), penetration here, mana regeneration on the Eaves (Long Chant). Two elemental damage smalls on the join's side, one on Harsh Weather's: they were plain spell damage until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/builds.md finding 1), so every caster took the cluster whatever its partner; now they are the elemental caster's, the partner penetration serves, and the plain spell damage is on the notable.

nodes.why: The entrance from the east join, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Piercing Word
nodes.why: 2.5 + 2 units.
The exit, on the straight line to Harsh Weather's notable.

clusters.name: High Veil
clusters.why: Energy shield with all elemental resistances (G3 round 1, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-4, the ledger's shield section MY-s4 folded in): the far shield cluster at the top left, paired with resistances, not offence. A four-node ring at the head of the north-west rim road, which lands on its west side, so the notable, on the outer side, is a step off the road (G1/mystic.md: the rim roads land on smalls, never on notables). Reached only from the rim road from G3 round 2 (2026-10-22, the user's ask): round 1 also joined it to Steady Stream, and the classic caster took it in its 60-point plan through Steady Stream and finished its energy shield by 120 points. G4 fix 2 (2026-10-23, audit/growth-2 network finding 3) joined it to Steady Stream again: re-tested with the seams in, the loop widened the choices of five casters and narrowed only the classic caster's at 60, and the cul-de-sac of ten nodes became a loop. 23 steps from the Mystic start, through the climb and Steady Stream, still a long way past the channelled spells.

nodes.why: The south-east side, where Steady Stream arrives (G3 round 1, cut in round 2, back in G4 fix 2).

nodes.name: High Veil
nodes.why: 3 + 1.5 units. The outer side of the ring.
The north-west side, on the straight line of the rim road.
The inner side.

links.why: The road to Shatter onto the channelled spells.
The west climb's lower node onto Quickening (G4 fix 1): one leg of the arc.
Quickening onto the climb's upper node: the arc is a bridge between the climb's two nodes, so the climb has a branch at each and the recharge is never a toll on it.
The east join onto Piercing Word (G3 round 2): the join is a four-way now, Thunderhead, Flashpoint, Siphon and this.
Piercing Word onto Harsh Weather's notable: a bridge, so the chill-and-shock chain is no longer a dead end and the east join has a second way to the top that is not Shatter.

Steady Stream onto High Veil's south-east corner (G4 fix 2, 2026-10-23, fix-2.md M-4; audit/growth-2 network finding 3): the round-2 exception reversed. With Quickening on the west climb and the seams in, the loop widens the casters' choices instead of narrowing them, and the network's one cul-de-sac of several clusters becomes a loop: Steady Stream is a bridge, High Veil 23 steps from the Mystic start (was 27). Channelling and energy shield with resistances are different kinds, so the two do not make one shop.
High Veil's west side onto the head of the north-west rim road, on the road's straight line: the road walks onto the cluster's smalls, not its notable.
Harsh Weather's climb onto the caster's trap.
Fever Pitch hangs off the road node between Shatter and Harsh Weather, so a lightning or fire crit build reaches it without buying Shatter (build audit 2026-10-20).
One intelligence node from the tip of Harsh Weather to Live Current's far small: Harsh Weather is a bridge again, four steps from Live Current, not one.
The far end of the road.
Two intelligence nodes from the Lantern junction up to Shatter's west side: the top of the Spire, Shatter and Fever Pitch had one way in, through Thunderhead.
The far end of the road.
The first cluster's west side to the west join.
The first cluster's east side to the east join.
The fire join to the Prismatic Balance spur.
The inter-arm link to the east arm.
Up through the notable to the arm's junction.
The east join onto Siphon (G2, MY-m2): the quick caster coming up the east arm reaches the recovery from hitting without Thunderhead.
Siphon onto the arm's junction through its second small: a bridge, so the junction has a way in from the east join that is not Thunderhead's notable.
Junction to the shatter room.
Intelligence once between Shatter and Harsh Weather.
The far end of the road.

name: The Spire gate
why: Two stat nodes off the start (shield west, crit east), the signature between them, two hubs one step out with a pocket each, and two intelligence highways: the well up the left, the craft up the right, bridged by Warm Blood.

clusters.name: First Light
clusters.why: The loop the start opens onto: energy shield on the west side, mana regeneration on the east, the signature at the tip. Point one is a side; point two is the signature, a hub, or a road.

nodes.why: The west side: defence, a flat shield (the user, 2026-10-25; it was 5% increased, which is nothing on a character who starts with almost none; 15 until the energy shield cut of docs/ATTRITION.md).

nodes.name: First Light
nodes.why: The signature: spell damage, mana, intelligence and a little shield. 4.6 units.
The east side: a generous mana regeneration, two units on one small, so a caster's first point keeps its spells going (the user, 2026-10-23; it was 15% crit chance).

clusters.name: The hubs
clusters.why: Intelligence, one step past each side node: the west hub joins the ring toward the Zealot and starts the well road; the east hub joins the ring toward the Shade and starts the craft road.

clusters.name: Still Mind
clusters.why: The west hub's pocket, a tight orbit: two mana regeneration nodes and a notable with regeneration and flat mana, on a half circle west of the hub and the road's first node. A caster's first worry is running dry; three points after the hub it stops being one.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the hub.

nodes.name: Still Mind
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units.

clusters.name: Sharp Mind
clusters.why: The east hub's pocket, a tight orbit: two spell crit nodes and a notable with spell crit and spell crit multiplier, on a half circle east of the hub and the road's first node. The crit caster's first three points after the hub, and the way the insight charges start paying.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the hub.

nodes.name: Sharp Mind
nodes.why: 2 + 1.25 units.

clusters.name: The west road
clusters.why: Intelligence three times: the highway up the left from the west hub to the well's wheel, with Still Mind off its foot and the gate pocket off its middle.

clusters.name: The east road
clusters.why: Intelligence three times: the highway up the right from the east hub to the craft's wheel, with Sharp Mind off its foot and the gate pocket off its middle.

clusters.name: To the ring
clusters.why: One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.

clusters.name: To the ring
clusters.why: One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.

clusters.name: Warm Blood
clusters.why: A bridge across the gate between the two highways, at their middle nodes: life twice and the notable, the Spire's second life cluster (Quiet Pulse is far up the well). It fills the band outside the home and makes the two roads a loop.

nodes.name: Warm Blood
nodes.why: Life and a little shield: 2.4 + 1.2 units.

clusters.name: Deft Wand
clusters.why: A pocket east off the west road's first node, into the ground between the signature and Warm Blood: wand attacks twice, then wand attacks with accuracy and projectile speed. The second wand-attack cluster, six steps from the start, so the Mystic who starts with a wand attack has one near home; Wand Volley, thirteen out on the east side, sells wand attacks with speed (its crit went in G3), and Bright Wand in the Lantern wand attacks with elements. Round 3 (2026-10-20); it also breaks the home's mirror.

links.why: The west road onto the wand pocket.
The west highway onto the gate bridge.
The gate bridge onto the east highway.
Point one, the west side.
Point one, the east side.
The west side to the west hub.
The east side to the east hub.
The west hub's pocket.
The east hub's pocket.
One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.
The far end of the road.
One attribute node between the hub and the centre ring: the highway home, and a step further to the first other attribute.
The far end of the road.
The well road.
The craft road.
The well road reaches the wheel.
The craft road reaches the wheel.
The mana pocket is also a way onto the well road: a pocket as a bridge.
The crit pocket is also a way onto the craft road.

name: The Eaves
why: The Spire's north-east rim, under the eaves of the Rooftops next door: an outer road for the casters' far clusters and the Shade's way in from the roofs.

clusters.name: The eaves road
clusters.why: Intelligence five times, in three straight runs that turn at junctions: up from Harsh Weather's road node to the rim, along it, and down to the Rooftops. No stretch goes more than two nodes without something off it: Long Chant between r1 and r2, Snare Line at r3, Pinpoint at r4, Bad Company and the Rooftops at r5.

nodes.why: On the straight run from Harsh Weather's road node to r2. Long Chant (G3 round 3, G1/mystic.md MY-3) hangs here and at r2, outward, as a pocket bridging the two.
The corner where the road meets the rim and turns east, and the far end of Long Chant's pocket: a junction, so the turn is here.
The north-east corner, on the line of Snare Line's chain so the chain runs straight onto it.
Halfway down the run to the Rooftops. Pinpoint, the crit wand (G3 round 3, G1/mystic.md MY-6), hangs here, bridged to Live Current.

The last node before the Shade, so half dexterity, and the corner where the eaves road drops onto the Rooftops' ridge road beside Black Powder. Nudged east in the border pass (G2, 2026-10-22) so the run from r4 stays straight (8°) and the ridge node takes it as a clean T (75° and 120° from its two road links); on the straight line from r4 it would have met the ridge 31° from Black Powder's link. The turn is here, at the corner between two roads. Bad Company's ring (G3 round 3) hangs off the corner's inner side.

clusters.name: Long Chant
clusters.why: Spell damage with mana regeneration, on three cast speed smalls (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-3, the ledger's cast speed section MY-s5 folded in): the far spell cluster, for the caster who casts all fight long, the channeller among them. Spell damage's partners by direction: cast speed (Ready Wit), crit (Keen Verse), life (Living Verse), penetration (Piercing Word), and here the sustain to keep casting. A V pocket outward of the eaves road's first run, the notable at the tip, in the empty top between Fever Pitch's spur and the corner: a caster on the road pays two cast speed smalls from r1 or one from r2, and walking the road costs none of it. Not beside Steady Stream (channelling with cheaper mana would make the top left a one-stop for the channeller), and seven steps past Piercing Word through Harsh Weather and the road.

nodes.why: The entrance from r1, on the straight line from r1 to the notable.
Beside the notable, on the same leg.

nodes.name: Long Chant
nodes.why: 2.5 + 1.5 units. The tip of the V, where the two legs meet.
The exit to r2, on the straight line from the notable.

clusters.name: Pinpoint
clusters.why: Wand attacks with crit chance and crit multiplier with wands (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-6): the crit wand, the fourth wand-attack cluster, each with its own partner and direction (accuracy at home, speed on the Scriptorium (Wand Volley), elements in the Lantern (Bright Wand), crit here). East and up is the Mystic's crit side. A bridge from Live Current's east small to the eaves road: the wand attacker coming up the Gallery pays the shock ring's smalls to reach it, and an intelligence-and-dexterity Shade from the Rooftops comes down the eaves road. A V with the bend at the notable, so it reaches r4 near the even fan of its three links and leaves Live Current's ring from its outer side. Since G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22) its notable is also the Mystic end of the Mystic–Shade seam: Needlework (attack speed with crit chance) leads on from it to Black Powder.

nodes.why: The entrance from Live Current's east small, on the straight line to the notable.
Beside the notable, on the same leg.
The exit to r4, on the straight line from the notable (the rim road lands on a small, not the notable).

clusters.name: Bad Company
clusters.why: Minion damage with curse effect (G3 round 3, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-7): the hexing summoner, whose minions hit what its curses weaken. The Spire's second minion cluster, with a different partner from Familiars (minion life, west) and in the other direction from every other minion cluster a Mystic summoner reaches (Familiars and Volatile Servants north-west, the Zealot's Shepherd, Sexton and Ossuary west): a summoner picks the west's minions or this corner's, and taking both costs a crossing of the whole top. It sits by the Shade's door, a few steps above the Shade's curses (Ill Wish on the Rooftops, Second Curse further in), where the curse class and the summon class meet. The brief put it on the north-west rim road; laid there first, it made the north-west a summoner's one-stop (Familiars, it, High Veil's shield, Volatile Servants and Tomb Dust, all taken by 120 points). A four-node ring pocket off the corner over the Rooftops, its entrance facing the corner, the notable on the far side: a dead end on purpose (CONSTRAINTS §13.5, a far tip), since the corner has no second way in that is not a link across the border.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the corner.
A side of the ring.

nodes.name: Bad Company
nodes.why: 2 + 2 units. The far side of the ring.
The other side of the ring.

clusters.name: Needlework
clusters.why: Attack speed with crit chance (G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22; fix-1.md §1.1 seam 3): the Mystic–Shade seam cluster, for the quick, precise attacker from either side: the wand attacker coming down from Pinpoint, and the Shade's dagger and claw attackers coming up from Black Powder. Attack speed is the family both sides were thin in (the Mystic sold no attack speed, the Shade only weapon-specific speed), and crit chance is weighed by both sides' attackers and crit casters alike. A bridge on the straight line from Pinpoint's notable to Black Powder's, between Pain Conduit's keystone (below) and Bad Company (east), clear of both: two crit smalls on Pinpoint's side and one on Black Powder's, every small beside the notable and the room on the two end links. Three steps from Pinpoint, so the wand attacker who wants both pays for them (CONSTRAINTS §5.5). Twins: no other notable pairs attack speed with crit chance.

nodes.why: The entrance from Pinpoint's notable, on the straight line to the notable.

nodes.name: Needlework
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units.
The Shade side, on the straight line to Black Powder's notable.

links.why: Pinpoint onto the seam cluster (G4 fix 1): the crit wand notable becomes a junction toward the Shade.

The Mystic–Shade seam (G4 fix 1, fix-1.md §1.1 seam 3): Needlework onto Black Powder's notable, so the mine pocket at the top of the Stair and the crit wand on the Eaves are joined through a cluster both sides' attackers want, not a bare link. Far from both starts (20 steps from the Shade start, 22 from the Mystic start).
The corner over the Rooftops onto Bad Company's ring, inward, bisecting the corner's free side (about 55° from each road link).
The road node between Shatter and Harsh Weather onto the eaves road: the top of the Spire's two rim roads meet across it, through Shatter.
Snare Line onto the eaves road: a dead-end pocket until G2, now a bridge from Harsh Weather's climb to the rim (G1/mystic.md §4).
The eaves road's first run onto Long Chant's longer leg, square-ish to the road (about 60° either side of the notable's line).
Long Chant's short leg onto the corner: the pocket is a bridge, two ways in, and the corner becomes a junction.
Live Current's east small (the ring's outer side) onto the crit wand: the Gallery's way up to the eaves road that is not Harsh Weather's climb.
Pinpoint onto the eaves road at r4, arriving at r4 between its two road links (83° from r3's, 105° from r5's) rather than 31° off the even fan the straight line from Live Current would give.

The Rooftops road (a dear crossing; G1-brief.md §2.1, laid in the G2 border pass): the eaves road comes down onto the Shade's ridge road one step from Black Powder. Traps and mines (Snare Line, Black Powder), cold (Shatter, Sleet) and the crit wand for an intelligence-and-dexterity Shade; the Mystic's trapper and the far casters reach the Rooftops. Far from both starts (about 20 to 25 steps), so it is a late build's road, not a shortcut.

name: The Gallery
why: The arm toward the Knife, the sharp end of the Spire: fire for the crit caster, lightning for the shocker, and Pain Conduit for the caster who lives on low life. The Shade borrows its root; the dear crossing from the Knife's curses lands on the keystone spur.

clusters.name: Flashpoint
clusters.why: Fire with spell crit and fire penetration: fire as the big crit hit, the first cluster of the east arm, beside the Spire's other crit (Sharp Mind below, Fever Pitch above). The other fire cluster (Cinder, west) sells the burn; a fire build picks the hit here or the burn there. Passed through from the fork to the arm's junction; its west side takes the join from the middle arm.

nodes.why: The entrance, from the fork.
The north-west side, to the east join.
The east exit, to the arm's junction.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The arm's junction: the shock room north, the Pain Conduit spur east, the craft's east road arriving from the south, and the dear crossing to the Knife's curses south-east.

clusters.name: Live Current
clusters.why: Lightning damage, the effect of shock and lightning penetration: lightning as the shock that makes every later hit bigger, beside the low-life keystone. The other lightning cluster (Thunderhead, the middle arm) sells speed. The middle arm's ailment bridge arrives at its notable.

nodes.why: The entrance, south, facing the junction.

nodes.name: Live Current
nodes.why: 1.2 + 2 + 1.5 units. The west side, where the ailment bridge arrives.
The east side, to the keystone spur.

clusters.name: Pain Conduit
clusters.why: Two nodes of damage on low life, then the keystone: 30% more spell damage on low life. The tip of the lightning arm; the approach says what the keystone asks (they were spell damage until 2026-10-19).

clusters.name: The gallery stair
clusters.why: Intelligence once, between the Gallery junction and Mist Walk.

links.why: Through the first cluster to the arm's junction.
Junction to the shock room.
Junction to the keystone spur.

name: The Cloister
why: The quiet side of the Spire, toward the Cathedral: mana and shield on the wheel, the wand caster's chain beside the mana, flasks, life, leech, and Mind Bulwark. Defence leans west and spell damage leans east, but neither side holds all of its kind.

clusters.name: Deep Well
clusters.why: The wheel: entered from the well road on the south-east, left to the junction on the west and to the column through the shield notable. Mana and cast speed on the south side, shield on the north (since G3 round 2: speed or shield).

nodes.why: The entrance, south-east.

nodes.name: Deep Well
nodes.why: Mana and the cast speed it pays for: 2 + 2 units. Mana and its regeneration (4.5) until G3 round 2 (2026-10-22, CONSTRAINTS §4.8): the Cloister within 14 steps of the start held 6 units of offence against 42 of defence and sustain (shield, life, block, flasks, mana), the wand caster's cluster its only offence, so a caster's first points west were a corridor of one kind. Now the wheel's two sides are speed or shield, as the east wheel's are spell damage or chaos resistance. The regeneration stays at home (Still Mind) and in Frugal, Draught and Warded Mind. The wand chain leaves here.
The north-west exit, to the junction.

nodes.name: Glass Skin
nodes.why: Shield and the mana it sits beside: 3.2 + 1.25 units. The north-east exit, to the column. ES with recharge until G3 (2026-10-22, G1/mystic.md MY-r2): with Quickening moved away, the two would have been one pairing twice; Glass Skin is now the wheel's shield with mana, beside both mana keystones, and Quickening keeps the recharge, up the Belfry's west climb since G4 fix 1.

clusters.name: Wandwork
clusters.why: The wand caster's cluster, here beside the mana and not beside the spell damage: spell damage and cast speed while wielding a wand, off the mana notable. A wand caster who comes west for this passes the mana and the shield; the east wheel's spell damage is the other way to spend the same points. (Until 2026-10-20 it sat on the east wheel, one step from every other spell node, and the cost chain was here.)

nodes.why: One unit of wand spell damage (10% until G4 fix 1, 2026-10-22: a small is one unit).

nodes.name: Wandwork
nodes.why: 2.5 + 2 units, both behind the wand in hand.

clusters.name: Draught
clusters.why: Flask effect twice, then the notable with flask effect, flask duration and mana regeneration: the caster's flasks. A bridge since G4 fix 2 (2026-10-23, fix-2.md M-3; audit/growth-2 trade-offs T2): a tent with the notable at its tip, one small on each leg. The south leg's small is the junction where both crossings from the Cathedral land (the east road's, from Hymn's side, and the choir's, from Shepherd); the east leg's small goes on to the Cloister junction and to Wandwork. Until then Draught was a dead end off a small that the crossing reached through Wandwork, and five Zealot casters walked that road into the Cloister for their first 60 points; now a Zealot coming this way pays a flask notable first (CONSTRAINTS §5.5's fair price), and the Mystic's own Draught is a step nearer. The aura cluster that sat here moved east (2026-10-20), so the crossings join two different things, not two aura clusters a step apart.

nodes.why: The east leg, on the line from the notable to the Cloister junction; Wandwork's link arrives here too.
The south leg: the head of the east-road crossing, and where the choir crossing lands.

nodes.name: Draught
nodes.why: The caster's flasks: 2 + 1 + 1 units. The tip of the tent.

clusters.name: Junction
clusters.why: The well's junction, west of the wheel: the Mind Bulwark spur north-west, Wandwork, and Draught, where the near crossings to the Cathedral land (since G4 fix 2).

clusters.name: Quiet Pulse
clusters.why: Life: the Spire had none. Two life nodes and a notable with life, regeneration and a little shield, a tight orbit above the junction and the first step of the west road; its notable also leads toward the Column (`toPulse`).

nodes.why: The entrance, facing the junction.

clusters.name: Mana Tap
clusters.why: Mana leech with spells, then the notable with leech and mana on hit: the caster who hits often and casts without a pause, the second pocket of the west road, landing on the fire arm's junction.

nodes.why: The entrance, facing Quiet Pulse.

nodes.name: Mana Tap
nodes.why: 2 + 1.5 units.

clusters.name: Spirit Ward
clusters.why: The caster's shield: a wand is one-handed, and the off-hand holds a shield of energy shield. Shield defences twice, then the notable with spell block behind a shield, mana on block and shield defences. The way up from the shield notable to the column now runs through it (it ran straight before), so the climb on the shield side costs the shield pocket, as the climb on the craft side costs the wheel.

nodes.why: The entrance, from Glass Skin.

nodes.name: Spirit Ward
nodes.why: 2 + 1 + 1 units; spell block is what a caster's shield is for.
The exit, to the column's junction.

clusters.name: Mind Bulwark
clusters.why: Two nodes of mana, then the keystone: 30% of damage is taken from mana before life. The first keystone of the Spire; a caster's mana is the only pool a caster already has plenty of.

clusters.name: To the Cathedral
clusters.why: The near crossing to the Cathedral (audit 2026-10-20). Two attribute nodes on one straight run from Draught's south leg down to the second node of the Zealot's east road. G4 fix 2 (2026-10-23) moved both ends. The Zealot end left Hymn's far small (fix-2.md M-1; audit/growth-2 starts F1, trade-offs T2, builds F2): the Zealot caster's first spell notable and the way out of its region were one purchase, and five Zealot casters spent their first 60 points in this Cloister; now Hymn is a porch off the road. With that alone four still did, so the Mystic end left Wandwork for Draught (M-3): the road reaches the Cloister through the flask notable, and Wandwork, Deep Well and Glass Skin are three steps farther from the Zealot.

nodes.why: Two thirds of the way from the east road to Draught's small, on the straight line.
A third of the way, on the same line; half strength, the last node before the Zealot.

clusters.name: To the Undercroft

clusters.name: Composure
clusters.why: Energy shield with avoid stun (G3 round 1, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-8, the ledger's shield section MY-s3 folded in): the shield for the caster who gets knocked out of its casts. A bridge from Quiet Pulse's road node up to Broad Weave, laid straight on the line between them, two avoid-stun smalls before the notable and one after, so it is the Cloister's way up to the Column now that Siphon has moved north. The smalls were energy shield until G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/builds.md finding 1, fix-1.md §1.2 item 9): every shield build took them, so the shield is on the notable and the smalls are its partner. Not linked to the Deep Well wheel: Glass Skin (shield with mana) is six steps away; the recharge (Quickening) moved to the Belfry's west climb in the same pass, so the shield caster's shield notables lie in three directions with three partners (mana at the wheel, stun here, recharge and hit recovery up the spine). 13 steps from the Mystic start.

clusters.name: Living Verse
clusters.why: Spell damage with life (G3 round 2, 2026-10-22; G1/mystic.md MY-2): the life caster's own pair, kept far from both homes as the convergence rule asks of such pairs. A bridge from the second node of the road to the Undercroft over to the Zealot's crossing road (the Undercroft bridge, G2/borders.md §4), laid straight on the line between the two, so the wedge between the two crossing roads becomes a loop. All three smalls are life since G4 fix 1 (2026-10-22, audit/growth-1/builds.md finding 1): the Mystic side's two were plain spell damage, so every caster took the cluster whatever its partner; now the smalls are the partner, the cluster is the life caster's, and the spell damage is on the notable. Spell damage in the west at last: the Cloister was shield, mana and life with only the wand caster's cluster for offence. 20 steps from the Mystic start, about 18 from the Zealot's; Quiet Pulse (life) is 8 away and Keen Verse (spell) the far side of the map.
